scientific_scope_status: Input is a prepared donor population, weak coupling J to one resonant acceptor with exponential amplitude memory exp(-kappa s), and a differential Stark vector d=d0 u with one supplied nonzero norm d0 and arbitrary fixed u in S^2. For periodic primitive Theta'=E, f_u=exp(i d0 u.Theta), Fourier coefficients c_n(u), and Omega=2pi/T, the model gives Gamma(u)=2J^2 sum_n |c_n|^2 kappa/(kappa^2+n^2 Omega^2), Gamma0=2J^2/kappa and A=d0 E_rms. These are initial leakage rates, not demonstrated molecular lifetimes or chemical yields. For scalar finite-RMS modulation, Jensen gives Gamma>=2J^2 kappa/(kappa^2+A^2), attained by static detuning. Static orientation-averaged Gamma/Gamma0=atan(x)/x, x=A/kappa. Its frozen-ensemble mean lifetime is instead (1+x^2/3)/Gamma0, and its worst-orientation lifetime remains 1/Gamma0.
